Node.js native addon binding `nacos-sdk-rust` to Nacos via napi-rs. Rust: `src/*.rs` (`lib.rs` ClientOptions; `config.rs` NacosConfigClient; `naming.rs` NacosNamingClient; `plugin.rs` encryption/decryption filter). `index.d.ts` auto-generated. Rust `Option<T>` → TS `T | undefined | null`; async methods → Promises; callbacks use `ThreadsafeFunction`; Nacos errors → JS `Error` with reason. Persistent gRPC subscriptions push updates.

Yarn 3.4.1; Cargo. Build: `yarn build:debug`; targets: `yarn build --target <target-triple>`. CI platforms in `.github/workflows/CI.yml`. Output: `nacos-sdk-rust-binding-node.<platform>.node`; definitions: `index.d.ts`. Tests (AVA, 3-minute timeout): `yarn test __test__/index.spec.mjs`; build `index.node` first.

Env: `NACOS_CLIENT_LOGGER_LEVEL` (default `INFO`, `$HOME/logs/nacos/`); `NACOS_CLIENT_COMMON_THREAD_CORES` (default `1`); `NACOS_CLIENT_NAMING_PUSH_EMPTY_PROTECTION` (default `true`). More: nacos-sdk-rust docs.

`removeListener/unSubscribe`: NOOPs; SDK lacks removal. Clients are stateful; create once, reuse for application lifecycle. Auth: HTTP token (username/password) or Alibaba Cloud RAM (access_key/access_secret). Build requires `nacos-sdk-rust` and `napi`. If build fails: `rustup update stable && cargo update`. Cross-compilation: see Docker images/setup in CI workflow. Native addon loading errors usually indicate platform/architecture mismatch.
